name: Charged Manaplate's Class Bonus banish-for-draw, gated on this-turn champion damage
notes: Creeping Torment was attempted first for this batch slot but abandoned -- its On Enter handler calls MZRemove(), a function that doesn't exist anywhere in the codebase (verified: 7 call sites across CardDQHandlers.php and GeneratedMacroCode.php, zero definitions), causing a PHP fatal error. Flagged separately as task_bdcead88. Charged Manaplate's element is NORM, so no lineage patch is needed, and its memory cost (0) needs no floating-payment setup. The ability requires both a GUARDIAN Class Bonus (physical presence, so Ciel, Loyal Valet is seeded directly onto the field) and the champion having taken 4+ damage this turn, which GetChampionDamageTakenThisTurn() reads directly from a Counters['_champDamageThisTurn'] entry on the champion object -- patched in directly rather than scripting a real combat/damage sequence.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] Banish CARDNAME: Draw a card. Activate this ability only if your champion has taken 4 or more damage this turn.
